Definition
[$\alpha $-small and $\alpha $-large curvature points] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0205 1. ch22:22.1\group Point picking

For $\alpha >0$, a space-time point $(x,t)$, $t>0$, is $\alpha $-small if $|\Rm |(x,t)\le \alpha /t$, and is $\alpha $-large if $|\Rm |(x,t)>\alpha /t$. The condition is invariant under the parabolic scaling $g_C(\tau )=Cg(\tau /C)$.
